summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for balance-audit reconciliation scope, including new draft legacy-settled coverage, and verified admin audit UI wording/integration on preview environment.
action_items: No blocking defects found in requested audit/reconciliation scope.
Keep running the new draft-legacy regression in future CI for this module.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview aggregator now correctly treats post-cutoff `legacy_settled=true` lines (including draft/pending/available) as wrongly-settled and includes them in expected balances.
Commit flow correctly clears legacy settlement markers for post-cutoff anomalies and preserves non-withdrawn statuses while only converting withdrawn->available.
Recalculation path continues to reuse current label percentage and import exchange rate, with stale watchdog and paid-cutoff guards still functioning in regression runs.
seed_data_creation: No standalone seed scripts executed. Tests used temporary labels/royalty/withdraw/job documents and cleaned all created data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression file covers the missing draft-status legacy marker path end-to-end (preview counts, commit behavior, status preservation, recalculation values, and zero-anomaly re-preview). UI check confirmed Indonesian wording and combined wrong-status summary card renders correctly from live API preview.
rca of the issue: Original bug class is reproducible when post-cutoff lines are legacy-marked but not withdrawn. Added regression now proves these lines are audited as anomalies, restored correctly on commit, and re-audited to zero markers. No API flow was MOCKED.
